name: Antique Greataxe
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Antique Greataxe

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Impactful
effects.tooltip: Impactful 2 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to ripple with force, dealing 2 to 12 force on each hit.

effects.name: Evil Outsider Bane
effects.tooltip: Evil Outsider Bane 2 : This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt monsters that bring ill intent from other planes, dealing an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Evil Outsiders.

effects.name: Melee Alacrity
effects.tooltip: Melee Alacrity 5% : Gain 5% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.

effects.name: Adamantine
effects.tooltip: Adamantine : Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

flavor_text: Lamden Wynn of the Golden Wing Inn kept this greataxe behind the bar in case of trouble. It's an old family heirloom, but he offered it to you as compensation for your efforts.
